description.value: Nook is a well-established Italian restaurant group with multiple Vancouver locations, serving housemade pastas and wood-fired pizzas in the cycling-friendly Olympic Village neighbourhood. The Olympic Village location sits near the seawall and the Cambie Bridge cycling corridor, making it a convenient mid-ride or post-ride meal stop. Indoor and outdoor seating are available, and pickup orders can be placed online.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 13m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 16m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 61m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 74m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Olympic Village location at 195 West 2nd Ave with phone 604-428-6248, matching OSM — though the postal code differs (OSM: V5Y 1B8; website: V5Y 4A1). The website explicitly offers pickup/delivery (Takeout = true) and the menu includes a GF pasta option and multiple vegetarian dishes (Vegetarian/vegan/GF = true). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V5Y 1B8, website shows V5Y 4A1 — address confirmation set to false pending verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Nook Olympic Village is an active, well-known restaurant in a high-traffic cycling area near the seawall; it offers takeout and GF/vegetarian options that are useful to touring cyclists, and is a clear Food & Drink directory fit.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists gluten-free option ('GF Organic Quinoa Pasta +3') and multiple vegetarian dishes (Margherita pizza, Ricotta pizza, Tonnarelli Cacio e Pepe, various salads)

wow_evidence: well-established Italian restaurant group with multiple Vancouver locations
